principle_violations.reason: All classes that extend PaymentProcessor implement the auth_sms() method, but some do not require it (e.g., PaypalPaymentProcessor and CreditCardPaymentProcessor).
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor the PaymentProcessor class into multiple interfaces so that each concrete implementation only implements methods it truly requires.

principle_violations.reason: The Main class directly depends on specific implementations of the PaymentProcessor, making it challenging to replace or introduce new payment processor types without modifying the Main class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a factory or dependency injection mechanism to abstract away the specific implementation details of PaymentProcessor.

PaymentProcessor paypalProcessor = new DebitCardPaymentProcessor("123456");
